compute_mse: compute the mean squared error between two JAX arrays using mse_fn
compute_mse_jitted: compute the mean squared error between two JAX arrays using the jitted mse_fn_jitted
compute_psnr: compute the PSNR value from a given MSE value using psnr_fn
compute_psnr_jitted: compute the PSNR value from a given MSE value using the jitted psnr_fn_jitted
compute_inverse_psnr: compute the MSE value from a given PSNR value using inverse_psnr_fn
